filters.label: Branch
filters.query: SELECT branch_id AS value, branch_name AS label FROM branches

cards.title: Active Beneficiaries
cards.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM beneficiaries WHERE active = 1

cards.title: Enrollments This Month
cards.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM beneficiaries WHERE MONTH(created_at) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(created_at) = YEAR(CURDATE())

cards.title: Avg Attendance Rate
cards.query: SELECT ROUND(AVG(attended) * 100, 1) AS value FROM attendance WHERE attendance_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)

cards.title: Unique Projects
cards.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT project_id) AS value FROM beneficiaries WHERE active = 1

cards.title: Daily Attendance Trend (Last 30 Days)
cards.query: SELECT attendance_date AS x, COUNT(*) AS y FROM attendance WHERE attendance_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY attendance_date ORDER BY attendance_date

cards.title: Beneficiaries by Gender
cards.query: SELECT gender AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM beneficiaries WHERE active = 1 GROUP BY gender

cards.title: Beneficiaries by Branch
cards.query: SELECT b.branch_name AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM beneficiaries be JOIN branches b ON be.branch_id = b.branch_id WHERE be.active = 1 GROUP BY b.branch_name ORDER BY value DESC

cards.title: Recent Beneficiaries
cards.query: SELECT beneficiary_id, CONCAT(first_name, ' ', last_name) AS name, branch_name, project_name, enrollment_date, active FROM beneficiaries be JOIN branches br ON be.branch_id = br.branch_id JOIN projects p ON be.project_id = p.project_id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10
